scenes.text: Identify, explain and apply the important ideas behind recording survey results.
Research question: states what we want to discover. Sample: is a smaller selected group.
Consent: means someone agrees to participate. Tally: records counts using marks. Conclusion: explains what the collected results suggest.
Collect a few harmless facts about classroom materials, NOT personal details. Make a paper chart with the terms Research question, Sample and Consent; explain what each means.
